This was Burries' first game with the second unit since Oct. 31, as Ryan Rollins moved back into the starting five, but the duo saw nearly equal workloads. Coach Taylor Jenkins might continue to mix and match next to Herro in his backcourt as he searches for a lineup that clicks.

The heavy workload is encouraging, but his production remains stronger when he supplements perimeter scoring with his playmaking numbers. He should…

news.headline: Podziemski closed with 15 points (5-12 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 5-6 FT), three rebounds, two assists and one steal in 32 minutes during Thursday's 126-98 loss to the Grizzlies.

He's maintained roughly 30 minutes per game recently, but Golden State's struggling offense without Stephen Curry (abdomen) has limited his playmaking opportunities. His fantasy ceiling depends on rediscovering his perimeter touch.

news.headline: Podziemski accumulated 10 points (5-13 FG, 0-5 3Pt, 0-2 FT), three rebounds and four assists over 29 minutes during Wednesday's 116-94 loss to the Mavericks.
